claim: さん is carded as "Three" only, though the book also teaches 〜さん as "Mr./Ms." and both meanings fed this one card.
evidence: Book ch2 Numbers: "3 さん san". Book ch3 Lesson 1 vocabulary: "〜さん . . . san Mr./Ms. . . ." (the chapter-2 kanaPool holds さん "Mr; Ms"). Card r-0d0fd2531ac7: target さん, English "Three".
fix: Make the English "Three; Mr./Ms. (after a name)" so one written form carries both meanings the book teaches.

claim: ご is carded as "Five" only, though the book also teaches 〜ご ". . . language", and the deck cards the sibling suffixes じん and ねんせい with their meanings.
evidence: Book ch2: "5 ご go". Book ch3 Lesson 1 vocabulary: "*〜ご . . . go . . . language" (chapter-2 kanaPool: ご "...language"). Card r-27a87259d93f: ご "Five"; compare r-a6f2cd3984e4 じん "...people (nationality)".

claim: せき carries only "Cough", though the book also prints せき "seat" in the RW1 long-vowel pairs that the deck already draws しゅじん and しゅうじん from.
evidence: Book ch14 Lesson 12: "せき cough". Book ch15 RW1: "5. せいき (century) — せき (seat)" beside "3. しゅじん (husband) — しゅうじん (prisoner)". Card r-29c26602d23e: せき "Cough".
fix: Make the English "Cough; seat", or leave it if the RW1 pairs are not meant to teach meanings (then reconsider しゅうじん too).

claim: あげる's English includes "To give", a meaning this book never teaches; the only あげる in Genki I is in 手をあげてください.
evidence: Book ch13 Lesson 11 Expressions: "手をあげてください。 Raise your hand." No other あげる in chapters 1 to 26. Card r-1cd72882c51d: "To give; to raise (a hand)".

claim: The target drops the お the book brackets, against the deck's own fullest-form convention.
evidence: Book ch23 Useful Expressions: "(お)たんじょうびおめでとう。(Happy Birthday)". The deck turns おやすみ(なさい) into おやすみなさい and ごちそうさま(でした) into ごちそうさまでした. Card r-f76f81e7a0e6: たんじょうびおめでとう.
fix: Change the target to おたんじょうびおめでとう (romaji otanjōbi omedetō).

claim: きれい is carded without the な the book prints, while every other な-adjective in the kana deck carries it.
evidence: Book ch7 Lesson 5 vocabulary: "きれい（な） beautiful; clean", and drills print きれいな. Cards: げんきな, ひまな, しずかな, にぎやかな, たいへんな all with な; r-2b8c515b4475 is きれい.
fix: Change the target to きれいな (romaji kirei na).
